institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_typ.name: institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_types_check
institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_typ.value: (cardinality(for_donation_types) > 0) AND (array_position(for_donation_types, NULL::text) IS NULL) AND (for_donation_types <@ ARRAY['zakat'::text, 'sadaqah'::text, 'general'::text])

institute_bank_accounts_check.name: institute_bank_accounts_check
institute_bank_accounts_check.value: (NULLIF(btrim(account_number), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) OR (NULLIF(btrim(iban), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)

media_read.name: media_read
media_read.using:
(select app.has_role('admin')) or (
  uploaded_by = (select app.current_user_id())
  and (select app.is_member() or app.has_role('donor'))
)

media_assets_check1.name: media_assets_check1
media_assets_check1.value:
(bytes > 0) AND (bytes <=
CASE
    WHEN (purpose = 'avatar'::text) THEN 60000
    WHEN (kind = 'image'::text) THEN 600000
    WHEN (kind = ANY (ARRAY['audio'::text, 'slides'::text])) THEN 10000000
    WHEN (kind = 'document'::text) THEN 5000000
    WHEN (kind = 'video'::text) THEN 25000000
    ELSE 0
END)

media_assets_check5.name: media_assets_check5
media_assets_check5.value: ((kind = 'youtube'::text) AND (youtube_id IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_key IS NULL) AND (mime_type IS NULL) AND (bytes IS NULL)) OR ((kind <> 'youtube'::text) AND (storage_key IS NOT NULL) AND (mime_type IS NOT NULL) AND (bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (youtube_id IS NULL))

user_read.name: user_read
user_read.using:
(id = (select app.current_user_id()) and status in ('active', 'left'))
  or (select app.has_role('admin'))

users_check.name: users_check
users_check.value: (email IS NOT NULL) OR (username IS NOT NULL)
